message: 恋の意識

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, Ria. What's wrong? It's rare for you to stay at school this late. If you don't hurry home, the security guard will get mad at you.」

name: Ria
message: 「I need to talk to you. It's important.」

name: Helena
message: 「So you were waiting for me, then?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... let's walk home together.」

name: Helena
message: 「So, what is this important talk about?」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, well. It's about Synn...」

name: Helena
message: 「Did something happen with Synn?」

name: Ria
message: 「H-He might... be in love with you, Sis.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my~~\s04 What a sinful woman I am. Too bad, though. My type is completely different.」

name: Ria
message: 「I... thought so.」

name: Helena
message: 「I thought you knew my type best of all, Ria.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then... why did you do something like that?」

name: Helena
message: 「Something like what?」

name: Ria
message: 「Teasing him like that when you don't even like him! Poor Synn!」

name: Helena
message: 「...Ah, you mean that earlier?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes! Taking advantage of the fact that Synn can't say no and doing whatever you want... Your pranks go way too far!」

name: Helena
message: 「You're right. I suppose I did get a little carried away. I'm sorry.」

name: Ria
message: 「O-Oh, yeah... as long as you understand, it's fine, but--」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, tell me. Why are you so worried about him?」

name: Helena
message: 「Did Synn ask you to? To ask how I feel, or maybe to tell me how he feels?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, it's not like that... Besides, nothing's even certain yet...」

name: Helena
message: 「Right? But what if he actually does have feelings for me--」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if you worry about him like that, he might just think you're sticking your nose where it doesn't belong, you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「I wonder if you actually realize that when you say those things?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, hey! Hey, Ria, come back~~!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, honestly. We're heading back to the same place anyway, where does she think she's going right now.」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, Ria really... getting all worked up and brooding over what happened earlier...」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez~~, she's just so darn cute.\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「When she acts like that, it just makes me want to tease her~~\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Though, Synn-chan and Ria both. Them being so dense about each other is also... quite a problem...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ahh, I'm so jealous. I need to hurry up and get swept off my feet by a cool, handsome older gentleman too.\s07」
